short_term_14d: Pfizer wins FDA approval for IBRANCE in HER2 positive breast cancer.
House committee investigates Pfizer over China trials. - Pfizer's CEO signals readiness for acquisitions.
Pfizer drug PADCEV plus Keytruda approved in Canada. - Pfizer GLP-1 drug passes preliminary review in China.
medium_term_50d: Pfizer wins FDA approval for IBRANCE in HER2 positive breast cancer.

Pfizer drug IBRANCE approved for metastatic breast cancer treatment. - Pfizer's CFO David Denton departs to become Nike's CFO. - Pfizer's lung cancer trial shows mixed Phase 3 results. - Pfizer dismissed from US states' generic drug price fixing lawsuit. - Pfizer declares third-quarter 2026 dividend of $0.43 per share. - Pfizer reaffirms fiscal year 2026 financial outlook.
Pfizer's lung cancer trial fails to show survival benefit. - FDA approves Pfizer's Ibrance for advanced breast cancer. - Pfizer's ADC drug trial in lung cancer fails.
